d: Anupam Gupta speaks to CIO of ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, Sankaran Naren, about his unique journey through India’s evolving stock markets. Drawing on decades of experience spanning the 70s to the present, Naren highlights how the country’s equity landscape has transformed over time, shaped by regulatory reforms, the rise of new industries, and the vital role played by institutional investors. He emphasizes the importance of rigorous project appraisal, sound corporate governance, and the crucial blend of knowledge and temperament in creating a successful, long-term investment strategy.
